## HEADNOTE
Sample Consumer Protection Act, 2010, Section 9 - limitation - a complaint must be filed within two years of the cause of action; delay may be condoned on sufficient cause.
## FACTS
The complainant discovered a defect in a vehicle in 2013 and filed a complaint in 2016, explaining that he had been hospitalised for most of 2014.
## ARGUMENTS
The dealer argued that the complaint was time-barred. The complainant argued that his illness was sufficient cause.
## REASONING
Section 9 fixes a two year period but permits condonation where the complainant shows sufficient cause for the whole of the delay. Hospitalisation covering part of the period does not explain the remaining delay.
## HOLDING
The complaint is time-barred because sufficient cause was not shown for the entire period of delay.
